
Two arXiv papers from the 2026-05-18 RSS scout meet ≥3 inclusion criteria with strong relevance to agentic workflow architecture: SDOF addresses multi-agent orchestration and state-constrained dispatch, while SkillSmith addresses skill compilation into runtime tool interfaces across the agent execution lifecycle.

## Suggestions

- [SDOF: Taming the Alignment Tax in Multi-Agent Orchestration with State-Constrained Dispatch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15204) — Proposes a state-constrained dispatch framework for multi-agent orchestration that mitigates alignment tax, with architectural patterns for agent coordination, state management, and reliable task routing.
  Section: Research Papers | Criteria: Architectural guidance for goal-directed agent systems (patterns, orchestration, state management), Tool-use and execution design across agent lifecycle stages (planning, execution, feedback, recovery), Empirical or practical grounding (case studies, benchmarks, production deployment evidence)

- [SkillSmith: Compiling Agent Skills into Boundary-Guided Runtime Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15215) — Introduces a skill compilation framework that translates agent capabilities into boundary-guided runtime interfaces, addressing tool-use design and execution lifecycle management for agentic systems.
  Section: Research Papers | Criteria: Architectural guidance for goal-directed agent systems (patterns, orchestration, state management), Tool-use and execution design across agent lifecycle stages (planning, execution, feedback, recovery), Empirical or practical grounding (case studies, benchmarks, production deployment evidence)
